title.zh: 卷一百〇七 志第六十 禮十
title.raw: 卷一百〇七 志第六十 禮十 Volume 107 Treatises 60: Rites 10

sentences.zh: 宗廟之禮。

translations.literal: Rites of the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Rites of the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 每歲以四孟月及季冬，凡五享，朔、望則上食、薦新。

translations.literal: Each year, in the four first months of the seasons and the last month of winter, there are five offerings in all; on the new moon and full moon food is presented and the new harvest is offered.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the court holds five seasonal offerings—in the four opening months of the seasons and the last month of winter—and on the new and full moons presents food and offers the new harvest.

sentences.zh: 三年一祫，以孟冬；

translations.literal: Every three years a xia sacrifice, in early winter;
translations.idiomatic: Every three years a xia rite was held in early winter;

sentences.zh: 五年一禘，以孟夏，唯親郊、封祀。

translations.literal: Every five years a di sacrifice, in early summer—except when the emperor personally conducts the suburban sacrifice or the feng and shan sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: every five years a di rite in early summer, except when the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice or the feng and shan rites.

sentences.zh: 又有朝享、告謝及新主祔謁，皆大祀也。

translations.literal: There were also court audience offerings, thanksgiving announcements, and enshrinement audiences for new spirit tablets—all great sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: There were also court offerings, thanksgiving rites, and audiences when new spirit tablets were enshrined—all counted as great sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 二薦，則行一獻禮。

translations.literal: For the two seasonal offerings, the single-presentation rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the two seasonal offerings, only the single-presentation rite was used.

sentences.zh: 其祔祭，春祀司命及戶，夏祀灶，季夏祀中霤，秋祀門及厲，冬祀行，惟臘享、禘祫則遍祀焉。

translations.literal: For collateral sacrifices: in spring the Director of Fate and the Household were sacrificed to; in summer the Stove; in the last summer month the Central Court; in autumn the Gate and the Plague Spirit; in winter the Pathway—only at the La festival offering and the di and xia rites were all sacrificed to together.
translations.idiomatic: Collateral sacrifices were distributed through the year: in spring to the Director of Fate and the Household; in summer to the Stove; in the last summer month to the Central Court; in autumn to the Gate and the Plague Spirit; in winter to the Pathway—only at the La offering and the di and xia rites were all of them worshipped together.

sentences.zh: 禘祫之禮。

translations.literal: Rites of the di and xia sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Di and Xia Rites.

sentences.zh: 真宗咸平二年八月，太常禮院言：「今年冬祭畫日，以十月六日薦享太廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Xianping of Emperor Zhenzong, the Court of Imperial Rites of the Ministry of Ceremonies stated: "The date for this year's winter sacrifice has been set: on the sixth day of the tenth month an offering will be presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Xianping 2 under Emperor Zhenzong, the Court of Imperial Rites reported: "The winter sacrifice for this year has been scheduled for the sixth day of the tenth month, when offerings will be presented at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 按《禮》，三年一祫，以孟冬。

translations.literal: According to the Rites, every three years there is a xia sacrifice, in early winter.
translations.idiomatic: According to the canonical Rites, a xia sacrifice comes every three years, in early winter.

sentences.zh: 又《疑義》云：三年喪畢，遭禘則禘，遭袷 則袷。

translations.literal: The Doubts on the Rites also says: When the three-year mourning is complete, if a di sacrifice is due then perform the di; if a xia is due then perform the xia.
translations.idiomatic: The Doubts on the Rites likewise states that once the three-year mourning is finished, whichever great rite falls due—di or xia—should be performed.

sentences.zh: 宜改孟冬薦享為祫享。

translations.literal: The early-winter offering should be changed to a xia offering.
translations.idiomatic: The early-winter seasonal offering should therefore be conducted as a xia rite.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗天聖元年，禮官言：「真宗神主祔廟，已行吉祭，三年之制，又從易月之文，自天禧二年四月禘享，至今已及五年，合行禘禮。

translations.literal: " In the first year of Tiansheng of Emperor Renzong, the ritual officials stated: "Emperor Zhenzong's spirit tablet has been enshrined in the temple, the auspicious sacrifice has been performed, and the three-year regulation, following the text on abbreviated mourning, has passed since the di offering in the fourth month of the second year of Tianxi; it has now been five years, and the di rite should be performed.
translations.idiomatic: " In Renzong's first year of Tiansheng, ritual officials argued: "Now that Emperor Zhenzong's tablet has been enshrined and the auspicious rites completed, and with the three-year mourning period shortened as permitted, it has been five years since the di offering in the fourth month of Tianxi 2—the di rite is due.

sentences.zh: 」遂以孟夏薦享為禘享。

translations.literal: " Accordingly the early-summer offering was made a di offering.
translations.idiomatic: " The court accordingly held the early-summer seasonal offering as a di rite.

sentences.zh: 八年九月，太常禮院言：「自天聖六年夏行禘享之禮，至此年十月，請以孟冬薦享為祫享。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year, the Court of Imperial Rites stated: "Since the di offering was performed in the summer of the sixth year of Tiansheng, by the tenth month of this year the early-winter offering should be made a xia offering.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 8, the Court of Imperial Rites reported: "Since the di rite was performed in the summer of Tiansheng 6, the early-winter offering this tenth month should be conducted as a xia rite.

sentences.zh: 」詔恭依。

translations.literal: " An edict approved this respectfully.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered that this be followed.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐四年十月，仁宗親 詣太廟行祫享禮，以宰臣富弼為祫享大禮使，韓琦為禮儀使，樞密使宋庠為儀仗使，參知政事曾公亮為橋道頓遞使，樞密副使程戡為鹵簿使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Jiayou, Emperor Renzong personally went to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to perform the xia offering. The chief minister Fu Bi was made grand commissioner for the xia rite, Han Qi ritual commissioner, Privy Councilor Song Qi equipage commissioner, Vice Grand Councilor Zeng Gongliang bridge-and-escort commissioner, and Vice Privy Councilor Cheng Kan guard-of-honor commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Jiayou 4, Emperor Renzong went in person to the imperial ancestral temple for the xia rite. Chief minister Fu Bi served as grand commissioner of the xia ceremony, Han Qi as ritual commissioner, Privy Councilor Song Qi as equipage commissioner, Vice Grand Councilor Zeng Gongliang as bridge-and-escort commissioner, and Vice Privy Councilor Cheng Kan as guard-of-honor commissioner.

sentences.zh: 同判宗正寺趙良規請正 太祖東向位，禮官不敢決。

translations.literal: Zhao Lianggui, associate director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, requested that Emperor Taizu's east-facing seat be corrected, but the ritual officials dared not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Lianggui, associate director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, petitioned to restore Emperor Taizu to the east-facing seat, but the ritual officials would not settle the question.

sentences.zh: 觀文殿學士王舉正等議曰：「大祫之禮所以合昭穆，辨尊卑，必以受命之祖居東向之位。

translations.literal: Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature Wang Juzheng and others deliberated, saying: "The great xia rite serves to unite the zhao and mu lines and distinguish superior from inferior; the ancestor who received the Mandate must occupy the east-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Wang Juzheng and others argued: "The great xia rite joins the zhao and mu lines and fixes rank and precedence; the ancestor who received the Mandate must sit in the east-facing place.

sentences.zh: 本朝以太祖為受命之君，然僖祖以降，四廟在 上，故每遇大袷，止列昭穆而虛東向。

translations.literal: Our dynasty takes Emperor Taizu as the ruler who received the Mandate, yet from Emperor Xi onward four temples stand above him; therefore at each great xia only the zhao and mu are arrayed and the east-facing seat is left vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty regards Emperor Taizu as the Mandate-receiving sovereign, yet from Emperor Xi downward four ancestral shrines stand above him; at every great xia only the zhao and mu tablets are set out and the east-facing seat is left empty.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉以來，亦用此禮。

translations.literal: From Wei and Jin onward this rite has also been used.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and Jin had followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 今親享之盛，宜如舊便。」

translations.literal: For this grand personal offering, it is fitting to follow the old practice."
translations.idiomatic: For so solemn an offering in the emperor's own person, the established arrangement should stand."

sentences.zh: 禮官張洞、韓維言：「國朝每遇禘祫，奉別廟四後之主合食 太廟。

translations.literal: The ritual officials Zhang Dong and Han Wei stated: "Whenever our dynasty performs the di and xia rites, the spirit tablets of the four empresses from the separate temples are brought to share the feast at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials Zhang Dong and Han Wei argued: "At every di and xia our dynasty brings the tablets of the four empresses from their separate shrines to share the communal feast in the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 唐《郊祀志》載禘祫祝文，自獻祖至肅宗所配皆一後，惟睿宗二後，蓋昭成，明皇母也。

translations.literal: The Tang Record of Suburban Sacrifices records the di and xia prayer texts: from Emperor Xianzu to Emperor Suzong each had one consort paired, except Emperor Ruizong who had two consorts—Zhaocheng, mother of Emperor Minghuang.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's Record of Suburban Sacrifices shows that from Emperor Xianzu through Suzong each emperor had one consort paired in the rites; only Ruizong had two—Zhaocheng, mother of Emperor Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 《續曲台禮》有別廟皇后合食之文，蓋未有本室，遇祫享即祔祖姑 下。

translations.literal: The Continued Qu Terrace Rites contains text on empresses of separate temples sharing the feast—because they had no proper chamber, when a xia offering occurred they were enshrined below the founding ancestress.
translations.idiomatic: The Continued Qu Terrace Rites preserves language on empresses from separate shrines sharing the feast—when they lacked a main chamber, a xia rite placed them below the founding ancestress.

sentences.zh: 所以大順中，三太后配列禘祭，議者議其非禮。

translations.literal: Therefore in the Dazhun era three empress dowagers were paired in the di sacrifice, and deliberators criticized this as contrary to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That is why in the Dazhun era three empress dowagers were ranked in the di sacrifice—a step critics condemned as uncanonical.

sentences.zh: 臣謂每室既有定配，則餘後不當參列，義當革正。」

translations.literal: Your subjects hold that since each chamber already has its fixed pairing, the other empresses ought not to be ranked alongside; the practice should be reformed."
translations.idiomatic: We hold that once each chamber has its fixed consort, the other empresses should not be included—the practice ought to be corrected."

sentences.zh: 學士孫抃等議：「《春秋傳》曰：『大祫者 何，合祭也。

translations.literal: Academician Sun Bian and others deliberated: "The Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals says: 'What is the great xia? It is a joint sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Sun Bian and others argued: "The Spring and Autumn commentary asks, 'What is the great xia?'—a joint sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 未毀廟之主皆升合食於太祖。

translations.literal: The tablets of temples not yet removed to the distant shrine all ascend to share the feast with the founding ancestor.'
translations.idiomatic: Every tablet from shrines not yet moved to the distant hall ascends to feast with the founding ancestor.'

sentences.zh: 』是以國朝事宗廟百有餘年，至祫之日，別廟後主皆升合食，非無典據。

translations.literal: " Thus for more than a hundred years our dynasty has served the ancestral temple; on the day of the xia, the spirit tablets of empresses from separate temples all ascend to share the feast—this is not without canonical warrant.
translations.idiomatic: " Our dynasty has tended the ancestral temple for more than a century; on xia day the empresses' tablets from separate shrines have always joined the communal feast—hardly without precedent.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符中已曾定議，禮官著酌中之論，先帝有 『恭依』之詔。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong Xiangfu era a decision was already made; ritual officials wrote a balanced deliberation, and the late emperor issued an edict of respectful compliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong Xiangfu period the question was already settled; ritual officials drafted a balanced opinion, and the late emperor ordered it followed.

sentences.zh: 他年有司攝事，四後皆預。

translations.literal: In other years when officials performed the rite by proxy, all four empresses participated.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever officials conducted the rite in the emperor's stead, all four empresses took part.

sentences.zh: 今甫欲親祫而四後見黜，不亦疑於以禮之煩故邪？

translations.literal: Now, just as a personal xia is to be performed, the four empresses are to be dismissed—is this not suspect as being for the sake of avoiding ritual trouble?
translations.idiomatic: Now, on the eve of a xia the emperor will perform in person, the four empresses are to be excluded—does this not look like trimming ritual burden rather than honoring the ancestors?

sentences.zh: 宗廟之禮，至尊至重，苟未能盡祖宗之意，則莫若守舊禮。

translations.literal: The rites of the ancestral temple are supremely exalted and weighty; if one cannot fully fulfill the intent of the ancestors, then it is best to keep the old rites.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral rites are the most solemn of all; if we cannot fully satisfy our forebears' intent, we should keep the established practice.

sentences.zh: 臣等愚以謂 如故便。」

translations.literal: We your subjects humbly hold that the former practice is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: We humbly advise leaving matters as they have been."

sentences.zh: 學士歐陽修等曰：「古者宗廟之制，皆一帝一後。

translations.literal: Academician Ouyang Xiu and others said: "In antiquity the regulation of the ancestral temple was one emperor and one empress.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Ouyang Xiu and others argued: "In antiquity each emperor had one consort in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 後世有以子貴者，始著並祔之文，其不當祔者，則有別廟之祭。

translations.literal: In later ages those ennobled through their sons first had texts on joint enshrinement; those not fit for enshrinement had sacrifices at separate temples.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages, when a mother was honored through her son, joint enshrinement was codified; consorts not so enshrined received rites at separate shrines.

sentences.zh: 本朝禘祫，乃以別廟之後 列於配後之下，非惟於古無文，於今又四不可。

translations.literal: In our dynasty's di and xia rites, empresses from separate temples are ranked below the paired consort—this lacks not only ancient warrant but also presents four impossibilities today.
translations.idiomatic: Our di and xia rites rank empresses from separate shrines below the principal consort—without ancient precedent and, in the present case, with four further objections.

sentences.zh: 淑德，太宗之元配，列於元德之下；

translations.literal: Empress Shude, Taizong's primary consort, is ranked below Empress Yuande;
translations.idiomatic: Empress Shude, Taizong's first consort, is placed below Empress Yuande;

sentences.zh: 章懷，真宗之元配，列於章懿之下，一也。

translations.literal: Empress Zhanghuai, Zhenzong's primary consort, is ranked below Empress Zhangyi—the first objection.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zhanghuai, Zhenzong's first consort, stands below Empress Zhangyi—the first objection.

sentences.zh: 升祔之後，統以帝樂；

translations.literal: Enshrined consorts share the emperor's music;
translations.idiomatic: Enshrined consorts use the emperor's hymn;

sentences.zh: 別廟之後，則 以本室樂章自隨，二也。

translations.literal: Empresses of separate temples bring their own chamber's hymns—the second objection.
translations.idiomatic: empresses from separate shrines keep their own shrine hymns—the second objection.

sentences.zh: 升祔之後，同牢而祭，牲器祝冊亦統於帝；

translations.literal: Enshrined consorts sacrifice from the same pen; victims, vessels, and prayer texts are also unified under the emperor;
translations.idiomatic: Enshrined consorts share one victim and one set of vessels and prayer texts with the emperor;

sentences.zh: 別廟諸後，乃從專享，三也。

translations.literal: The various empresses of separate temples follow with separate offerings—the third objection.
translations.idiomatic: empresses from separate shrines receive separate offerings—the third objection.

sentences.zh: 升祔之後，聯席而坐；

translations.literal: Enshrined consorts sit on connected mats;
translations.idiomatic: Enshrined consorts sit on adjoining mats;

sentences.zh: 別廟之後，位乃相絕，四也。

translations.literal: Empresses of separate temples are placed far apart—the fourth objection.
translations.idiomatic: empresses from separate shrines are set far apart—the fourth objection.

sentences.zh: 章獻、章懿在 奉慈廟，每遇禘祫，本廟致享，最為得禮。

translations.literal: Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi are at the Fengci Temple; whenever di and xia occur, their own temple receives offerings—this is most in accord with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi are housed at the Fengci Shrine; at each di and xia their own shrine is served—most correct by ritual.

sentences.zh: 若四後各祭於廟，則其尊自申，是於禮無失。

translations.literal: If the four empresses each sacrifice at their own temple, their dignity is thereby expressed, and ritual is not violated.
translations.idiomatic: If all four empresses are worshipped in their own shrines, their rank is properly displayed without breach of ritual.

sentences.zh: 以為行之已久，重於改作，則是失禮之舉，無復是正也。

translations.literal: To hold that because the practice has long continued it is weighty to change—this is to treat a ritual violation as irreparable.
translations.idiomatic: To refuse reform because a wrong practice has lasted long is to treat a breach of ritual as beyond correction.

sentences.zh: 請從禮官。」

translations.literal: We request that the ritual officials' view be followed."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the ritual officials' proposal be adopted."

sentences.zh: 詔：「四後祫享依舊，須大禮畢，別加討論。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The four empresses shall share the xia offering as before; after the great rite is complete, discussion will be held separately.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered: "The four empresses shall continue to share the xia feast as before; after the great ceremony, the question will be reconsidered separately.

sentences.zh: 」仍詔：「祫享前一日，皇帝詣景靈宮，如南郊禮，衛士毋得迎駕呼萬歲。

translations.literal: " Another edict stated: "On the day before the xia offering, the emperor shall go to Jingling Palace as in the suburban sacrifice rite; guards must not greet the imperial procession with cries of 'Long live the emperor.'
translations.idiomatic: " It was further ordered that on the eve of the xia rite the emperor should visit Jingling Palace as for the suburban sacrifice, and that guards must not hail the procession with cries of "Long live!"

sentences.zh: 」有司言：「諸司奉禮，攝廩犧令省牲， 依《通禮》改正祀儀。

translations.literal: " The relevant offices stated: "All departments shall observe ritual propriety; the acting director of the imperial herds shall inspect the victims, and the sacrificial protocol shall be revised according to the Comprehensive Rites.
translations.idiomatic: " The responsible offices reported that all departments should observe ritual form, the acting director of imperial herds should inspect the victims, and the sacrificial protocol should be revised per the Comprehensive Rites.

sentences.zh: 散齋四日於別殿，致齋二日於大慶殿，一日於太廟。

translations.literal: Dispersed abstention for four days in a separate hall; concentrated abstention for two days in the Hall of Great Celebration and one day in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Dispersed fasting for four days in a side hall, concentrated fasting for two days in the Hall of Great Celebration and one day in the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 尚舍直殿下，設小次，御坐不設黃道褥位。

translations.literal: The Palace Supplies Office shall attend below the hall steps, set up a minor resting place, and not set out the yellow-path mat seat for the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Supplies Office was to attend below the hall steps, set up a minor resting pavilion, and omit the yellow-path mat for the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 七室各用一太牢，每坐簠簋二，鉶三，籩豆 為後，無黼扆、席幾。

translations.literal: Each of the seven chambers shall use one great victim; for each seat two grain vessels, three meat stands, and platters and cups behind—without embroidered screens, mats, or tables.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the seven chambers was to receive one great victim; at each seat two grain vessels, three meat stands, and platters and cups behind—with no embroidered screen, mat, or side table.

sentences.zh: 出三閣瑞石、篆書玉璽印、青玉環、金山陳於庭。

translations.literal: The auspicious stone from the Three Pavilions, the jade seal impressed with seal script, the green jade ring, and the golden mountain were displayed in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious stone from the Three Pavilions, the seal-script jade imperial seal, the green jade ring, and the golden mountain were displayed in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 別廟四後合食，牲樂奠拜無異儀。

translations.literal: The four empresses from separate temples shared the feast; victims, music, offerings, and obeisances followed the same protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The four empresses from separate shrines shared the feast, with victims, music, offerings, and obeisances performed by the same protocol.

sentences.zh: 故事，七祀、功臣無牲，止於廟牲肉分割，知廟卿行事。

translations.literal: By precedent, the seven collateral sacrifices and meritorious ministers had no victims of their own but only a portion of the temple victim's meat; the director of the temple conducted the rite.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the seven collateral spirits and meritorious ministers received no separate victims—only portions of the temple victim's meat—while the temple director conducted their rites.

sentences.zh: 請依《續曲台禮》，共料一羊，而獻官三員，功臣單席，如大中祥符加褥。」

translations.literal: We request that according to the Continued Qu Terrace Rites one sheep be allotted in common, with three presenting officials, and meritorious ministers on separate mats, as in the Dazhong Xiangfu addition of cushions."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that per the Continued Qu Terrace Rites one sheep be shared in common, with three presenting officials and meritorious ministers on separate mats, as in the Dazhong Xiangfu addition of cushions."

sentences.zh: 十月二日，命樞密副使張望告昊天上帝、皇地祇。

translations.literal: On the second day of the tenth month, Vice Privy Councilor Zhang Wang was ordered to announce to the Supreme Lord of Heaven and the Imperial Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the tenth month, Vice Privy Councilor Zhang Wang was dispatched to announce the rite to the Supreme Lord of Heaven and Imperial Earth.

sentences.zh: 帝齋大慶殿。

translations.literal: The emperor fasted in the Hall of Great Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor kept ritual abstention in the Hall of Great Celebration.

sentences.zh: 十一日， 服通天冠、絳紗袍，執圭、乘輿，至大慶殿門外降輿，乘大輦，至天興殿，薦享畢，齋於太廟。

translations.literal: On the eleventh day, wearing the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, holding the jade tablet and riding the imperial carriage, he descended from the carriage outside the Hall of Great Celebration, boarded the great palanquin, went to the Hall of Heavenly Prosperity, completed the offering, and fasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh day he wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, held the jade tablet, and rode the imperial carriage; outside the Hall of Great Celebration he transferred to the great palanquin, proceeded to the Hall of Heavenly Prosperity for the offering, then kept abstention at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 明日，帝常服至大次，改袞冕，行禮畢，質明，乘大輦還宮，更服靴 袍，禦紫宸殿，宰臣、百官賀，升宣德門肆赦。

translations.literal: The next day the emperor came in ordinary dress to the great resting place, changed into the dark ceremonial robes, completed the rites, and at dawn rode the great palanquin back to the palace; he changed into boots and robe, presided at the Hall of Purple Brightness, received congratulations from chief ministers and all officials, and ascended Xuande Gate to proclaim a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he came in ordinary dress to the great pavilion, changed into full ceremonial robes, and completed the rites; at dawn he returned by great palanquin, changed into court boots and robe, took the throne at the Hall of Purple Brightness to receive congratulations from ministers and officials, then ascended Xuande Gate to proclaim a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二十一日，詣諸觀寺行恭謝禮。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day he went to the various Daoist abbeys and Buddhist temples to perform the thanksgiving rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day he visited the Daoist abbeys and Buddhist temples to perform the thanksgiving rites.

sentences.zh: 二十六日，御集英殿為飲福宴。

translations.literal: On the twenty-sixth day he presided at the Hall of Assembled Excellence for the blessed-draught banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-sixth day he held the blessed-draught banquet at the Hall of Assembled Excellence.

sentences.zh: 治平元年，有司「準畫日，孟冬薦享改為祫祭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiping, the relevant offices stated: "According to the scheduled date, the early-winter offering is to be changed to a xia sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiping, the responsible offices reported: "Per the scheduled calendar, the early-winter seasonal offering is to be conducted as a xia sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 按《春秋》，閔公喪未除而行吉

translations.literal: According to the Spring and Autumn Annals, when Duke Min's mourning had not yet been completed an auspicious
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals records that while Duke Min's mourning was still incomplete an auspicious

sentences.zh: 禘，《三傳》譏之。

translations.literal: di sacrifice was performed, and the Three Commentaries condemned it.
translations.idiomatic: di rite was held, and all three commentaries condemned it.

sentences.zh: 真宗以咸平二年六月喪除，至十月乃祫祭。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong completed mourning in the sixth month of the second year of Xianping and did not perform the xia sacrifice until the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong ended mourning in the sixth month of Xianping 2 but did not hold the xia rite until the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 天聖元年在諒陰，有司誤通天禧舊禘之數，在再期內按行禘祭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiansheng, while still in mourning seclusion, the offices mistakenly followed the old Tianxi count for di sacrifices and performed a di sacrifice within the second mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiansheng 1, still in mourning seclusion, officials mistakenly applied the old Tianxi di schedule and held a di rite within the second mourning period.

sentences.zh: 以理推之，是二年冬應祫，而誤禘 於元年夏，故四十九年間九禘八祫，例皆太速。

translations.literal: Reasoning from principle, a xia should have come in the winter of the second year, but a di was mistakenly performed in the summer of the first year; thus over forty-nine years there were nine di and eight xia sacrifices, all on average too frequent.
translations.idiomatic: By rights a xia was due in the winter of year 2, but a di was wrongly held in the summer of year 1; over the next forty-nine years there were nine di and eight xia rites—each cycle too short.

sentences.zh: 事失於始，則歲月相乘，不得而正。

translations.literal: When the beginning is wrong, the months and years multiply the error and cannot be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Once the initial step was wrong, the error compounded year by year and could no longer be set right.

sentences.zh: 今在大祥內，禮未應袷，明年未禫，亦未應禘，至六月即吉，二月合行祫祭，乞 依舊時享，庶合典禮。」

translations.literal: Now, within the great auspicious mourning period, ritual does not yet call for a xia; next year, before the end of mourning, a di is also not yet due; only in the sixth month will auspicious rites be permissible, and in the second month a xia sacrifice would be proper—we beg that the regular seasonal offering be followed, so that canonical ritual may be fulfilled."
translations.idiomatic: We are still within the great auspicious mourning period, so a xia is not yet due; next year, before mourning ends, a di is likewise premature. Auspicious rites resume only in the sixth month, and a xia would be proper in the second month—we ask that the regular seasonal offering be held instead, in keeping with canonical ritual."

sentences.zh: 二年二月，翰林學士王珪等上議曰：「同知太常禮院呂夏卿狀：古者新君踐阼之三年，先君之喪二十七月為禫祭，然後新主祔 廟，特行禘祭，謂之始禘。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year, Hanlin Academician Wang Gui and others submitted a deliberation, stating: "Associate Director of the Court of Imperial Rites Lü Xiaqing reported: In antiquity, in the third year after a new ruler took the throne, when the former ruler's mourning of twenty-seven months ended with the end-of-mourning sacrifice, the new spirit tablet was enshrined in the temple and a special di sacrifice was performed, called the inaugural di.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 2, Hanlin Academician Wang Gui and others memorialized: "Associate Director Lü Xiaqing of the Court of Imperial Rites reported that in antiquity, in the new ruler's third year, when the twenty-seven-month mourning for the late sovereign ended with the end-of-mourning sacrifice, the new tablet was enshrined and a special di rite—the inaugural di—was performed.

sentences.zh: 是冬十月行袷祭，明年又行禘祭，自此五年，再為禘祫。

translations.literal: That winter in the tenth month the xia sacrifice was performed; the next year the di sacrifice was performed again; from then on every five years the di and xia were repeated.
translations.idiomatic: That winter's tenth month saw the xia rite; the following year the di rite; thereafter di and xia recurred every five years.

sentences.zh: 喪除必有禘祫者，為再大祭之本也。

translations.literal: That mourning's end must be followed by di and xia sacrifices is because they are the foundation of the two great sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The di and xia after mourning ends are the foundation of the two great succession rites.

sentences.zh: 今當袷祭，緣陛下未終三年之制，納有司之 說，十月依舊時享。

translations.literal: Now a xia sacrifice is due, but because Your Majesty has not yet completed the three-year regulation, accepting the offices' proposal, the regular seasonal offering will be held in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: A xia is now due, but because Your Majesty has not yet completed the three-year mourning, accepting the offices' view, the regular seasonal offering will be held in the tenth month instead.

sentences.zh: 然享廟、袷祭，其禮不同。

translations.literal: Yet the temple offering and the xia sacrifice differ in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Yet a seasonal temple offering and a xia rite are not the same ceremony.

sentences.zh: 故事，郊享之年遇祫未嘗權罷，唯罷臘祭。

translations.literal: By precedent, in years of suburban sacrifice when a xia fell due it was never provisionally suspended—only the La sacrifice was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, in years when the suburban sacrifice coincided with a xia, the xia was never set aside—only the La offering was suspended.

sentences.zh: 是則孟享與享廟嘗並行於季冬矣。

translations.literal: Thus the first-month offering and the temple offering have sometimes been performed together in the last month of winter.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the first-month offering and the temple offering have sometimes been held together in late winter.

sentences.zh: 其禘祫年數，乞一依太常禮院請，今年 十月行祫祭，明年四月行禘祭。

translations.literal: As for the interval for di and xia sacrifices, we beg that it follow entirely the request of the Court of Imperial Rites: perform the xia sacrifice this year in the tenth month and the di sacrifice next year in the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: For the di and xia schedule, we ask that the Court of Imperial Rites' proposal be followed in full: a xia this tenth month and a di next fourth month.

sentences.zh: 仍如夏卿議。

translations.literal: This still follows Xiaqing's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: This accords with Xiaqing's proposal as well.

sentences.zh: 」權罷今年臘享。

translations.literal: " The La offering for this year was provisionally suspended.
translations.idiomatic: " The La offering for that year was provisionally suspended.

sentences.zh: 熙寧八年，有司言：「已尊僖祖為太廟始祖，孟夏禘祭，當正東向之位。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xining, the relevant offices stated: "Emperor Xi has already been honored as founding ancestor of the Imperial Ancestral Temple; at the early-summer di sacrifice he should occupy the corrected east-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 8 the responsible offices reported: "Emperor Xi has been honored as founding ancestor of the imperial ancestral temple; at the early-summer di rite he should take the corrected east-facing seat.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「太廟禘祭神位，已尊始祖居東向之位，自順祖而下，昭、穆各以南北為序。

translations.literal: " They also stated: "For the di sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the founding ancestor has been honored with the east-facing seat; from Emperor Shun downward, zhao and mu are each ordered north and south.
translations.idiomatic: " They added that at the imperial ancestral temple di rite the founding ancestor now occupied the east-facing place, and from Emperor Shun downward the zhao and mu lines were ordered north and south.

sentences.zh: 自今禘祫，著為定禮。」

translations.literal: From now on for di and xia sacrifices, let this be established as fixed ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth di and xia were to follow this as fixed ritual."

sentences.zh: 元豐四年，詳定郊廟禮文所言：「禘祫之義，存於《周禮》、《春秋》，而不著其名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanfeng, the commission for determining suburban and temple ritual texts stated: "The meaning of the di and xia sacrifices is preserved in the Rites of Zhou and the Spring and Autumn Annals, but the names are not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 4 the commission revising suburban and temple ritual texts stated: "The di and xia rites are attested in the Rites of Zhou and the Spring and Autumn Annals, though the terms themselves are not named there.

sentences.zh: 行禮之年，經皆無文，唯《公羊傳》曰：『五年而再盛祭。

translations.literal: The years when the rites are performed have no text in the classics; only the Gongyang Commentary says: 'Every five years the great sacrifices are performed again.
translations.idiomatic: The years in which they fall are nowhere specified in the classics; only the Gongyang Commentary says, 'Every five years the great sacrifices recur.

sentences.zh: 』《禮緯》 曰：『三年一祫，五年一禘。

translations.literal: ' The Ritual Apocrypha says: 'Every three years a xia, every five years a di.'
translations.idiomatic: ' The Ritual Apocrypha states, 'A xia every three years, a di every five.'

sentences.zh: 』而又分為二說：鄭氏則曰：『前三後二』，謂禘後四十二月而祫，祫後十八月而禘。

translations.literal: ' Yet two interpretations divide: Zheng's school says 'three before, two after,' meaning twelve months after the di comes the xia, and eighteen months after the xia comes the di.
translations.idiomatic: ' Two schools disagree: Zheng's followers hold 'three before, two after'—twelve months after a di comes a xia, and eighteen months after a xia comes a di.

sentences.zh: 徐邈則曰：『前二後三』，謂二祭相去各三十 月。

translations.literal: Xu Miao says 'two before, three after,' meaning the two sacrifices are each thirty months apart.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Miao holds 'two before, three after,' meaning the two rites fall thirty months apart.

sentences.zh: 以二說考之，惟鄭氏曰：『魯禮，三年喪畢，祫於太廟，明年禘於群廟，自後五年而再盛祭，一祫一禘。

translations.literal: Comparing the two interpretations, only Zheng's school says: 'In Lu ritual, when the three-year mourning is complete, xia at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the next year di at the group of temples; thereafter every five years the great sacrifices recur, one xia and one di.'
translations.idiomatic: Of the two views, only Zheng's school states: 'In Lu ritual, when three-year mourning ends, xia at the imperial ancestral temple; the next year di at the group shrines; thereafter every five years the great rites recur—one xia, one di.'

sentences.zh: 』實為有據。

translations.literal: ' This truly has warrant.
translations.idiomatic: ' This view has solid warrant.

sentences.zh: 本朝慶曆初用徐邈說，每三十月一祭。

translations.literal: Our dynasty at the beginning of Qingli adopted Xu Miao's view, with one sacrifice every thirty months.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty at the opening of Qingli followed Xu Miao and held a sacrifice every thirty months.

sentences.zh: 熙 寧八年，既禘而祫，此有司之失也。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xining, di was performed and then xia—this was the offices' error.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 8 a di was followed immediately by a xia—an error by the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 請今十八月而禘，禘四十二月而祫，庶幾舉禮不煩，事神不瀆。

translations.literal: We request that hereafter di come after eighteen months and xia after forty-two months from di, so that ritual may not be burdensome and the spirits not be profaned.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that henceforth a di follow eighteen months after a xia and a xia forty-two months after a di, so ritual is not excessive and the spirits not profaned.

sentences.zh: 」太常禮院言：「本朝自慶曆以來，皆三十月而一祭。

translations.literal: " The Court of Imperial Rites stated: "Since Qingli in our dynasty, sacrifices have been held every thirty months.
translations.idiomatic: " The Court of Imperial Rites replied: "Since Qingli our dynasty has held a sacrifice every thirty months.

sentences.zh: 至熙寧五 年後，始不通計，遂至八年禘祫並在一歲。

translations.literal: After the fifth year of Xining the count was no longer kept correctly, so that in the eighth year di and xia fell in the same year.
translations.idiomatic: After Xining 5 the schedule was no longer reckoned correctly, until in year 8 both di and xia fell in a single year.

sentences.zh: 昨元豐三年四月已行禘禮，今年若依舊例，十月行祫享，即比年頻袷，復踵前失。

translations.literal: Last year in the fourth month of Yuanfeng 3 the di rite was already performed; if this year the old practice is followed and a xia offering is held in the tenth month, xia sacrifices will come in successive years and the earlier error will be repeated.
translations.idiomatic: The di rite was already performed in the fourth month of Yuanfeng 3; if this year the old practice is followed with a xia in the tenth month, xia rites will come in quick succession and repeat the earlier mistake.

sentences.zh: 請依慶曆以來之制，通計年數，皆三十 月而祭。

translations.literal: We request that the regulation since Qingli be followed, reckoning the years in full, with sacrifices every thirty months.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the Qingli practice be restored: count the full interval and hold a sacrifice every thirty months.

sentences.zh: 」詔如見行典禮。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered that the currently practiced canonical ritual be followed.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered that the ritual then in force be followed.

sentences.zh: 詳定所又言：「古者稞獻、饋食，禴祠、烝、嘗，並為先王之享，未嘗廢一時之祭。

translations.literal: The commission for determining ritual texts also stated: "In antiquity presentation libations and feeding offerings, spring and autumn sacrifices, winter and summer offerings were all part of the former kings' worship, and seasonal sacrifices were never suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual commission added: "In antiquity libation presentations, feeding rites, and the spring, autumn, winter, and summer offerings were all part of the former kings' worship—no seasonal sacrifice was ever set aside.

sentences.zh: 故孔氏《正義》以為：『天子夏為大祭 之禘，不廢時祭之礿；

translations.literal: Therefore Kong's Correct Meaning holds: 'In summer the Son of Heaven performs the great di sacrifice, yet does not suspend the seasonal yue offering;
translations.idiomatic: Kong Yingda's Correct Meaning therefore states: 'In summer the Son of Heaven holds the great di rite yet does not suspend the seasonal yue offering;

sentences.zh: 秋為大祭之祫，不廢時祭之嘗。

translations.literal: In autumn he performs the great xia sacrifice, yet does not suspend the seasonal chang offering.'
translations.idiomatic: in autumn he holds the great xia rite yet does not suspend the seasonal chang offering.'

sentences.zh: 』則王禮三年一袷與禘享，更為時祭。

translations.literal: ' Thus in royal ritual the xia and di every three and five years are in addition to the seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thus in royal ritual the triennial xia and quinquennial di are added to, not substituted for, the seasonal offerings.

sentences.zh: 本朝沿襲故常，久未厘正，請每禘祫之月雖已大祭，仍行時享，以嚴天 子備禮，所以丕崇祖宗之義。

translations.literal: Our dynasty has followed old custom and long failed to correct this; we request that in months of di and xia, though the great sacrifice has been performed, seasonal offerings still be held, so that the Son of Heaven's full ritual may be strict and the meaning of greatly honoring the ancestors fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty has long followed old custom without correction; we ask that even in months when di or xia is performed, the seasonal temple offering still be held, so the Son of Heaven's full ritual is preserved and the ancestors greatly honored.

sentences.zh: 其郊禮、親祠準此。」

translations.literal: Suburban sacrifice and personal temple worship should follow this rule."
translations.idiomatic: Suburban sacrifice and personal temple worship should follow the same rule."

sentences.zh: 又言：「《禮》：不王不禘。

translations.literal: They also stated: "The Rites say: Only a true king may perform the di.
translations.idiomatic: They also stated: "The Rites declare: only a true king may perform the di.

sentences.zh: 虞、夏、商、周四代所禘，皆以帝有天下，其世係所出者明，故追祭 所及者遠也。

translations.literal: The di performed in the four ages of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou all occurred because the emperor possessed All under Heaven and the lineage of descent was clear; therefore the reach of retrospective sacrifice was far.
translations.idiomatic: The di rites of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou were all performed because the sovereign held the realm and his line of descent was clear—so retrospective worship could reach far back.

sentences.zh: 太祖受命，祭四親廟，推僖祖而上所自出者，譜失其傳，有司因仍舊說，禘祫皆合群廟之主，綴食於始祖，失禮莫甚。

translations.literal: When Taizu received the Mandate he sacrificed at the four close ancestral temples; tracing above Emperor Xi to the one from whom he sprang, the genealogy lost its transmission; the offices followed the old account, and at di and xia all tablets from the group of temples were joined in feast at the founding ancestor—nothing was more contrary to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu received the Mandate he worshipped at the four close ancestral shrines; tracing above Emperor Xi to the dynastic founder, the genealogy was lost; officials followed the old story and at every di and xia combined all shrine tablets in feast at the founding ancestor—a grave breach of ritual.

sentences.zh: 今國家世係與四代不同，既求其 祖之所自出而不得，則禘禮當闕，必推見祖係乃可以行。

translations.literal: Now our state's lineage differs from the four dynasties; since the ancestor from whom one sprang cannot be found, the di rite should be omitted, and it can be performed only when the visible ancestral line is established.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's lineage differs from those four ages; since the founding ancestor cannot be identified, the di rite should be omitted until the visible ancestral line is established.

sentences.zh: 」神宗謂輔臣曰：「禘者，本以審禘祖之所自出，故禮，不王不禘。

translations.literal: " Emperor Shenzong said to his chief ministers: "The di rite is fundamentally for discerning the ancestor from whom one sprang; therefore the Rites say, only a true king may perform the di.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Shenzong told his chief ministers: "The di rite exists to identify the ancestor from whom one sprang; hence the Rites: only a true king may perform the di.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢以後，譜牒不明，莫知其祖之所 自出，由禘禮可廢也。」

translations.literal: From Qin and Han onward genealogies were unclear and no one knew the ancestor from whom one sprang; therefore the di rite may be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: From Qin and Han onward genealogies were unclear and the founding ancestor unknown—so the di rite may be set aside."

sentences.zh: 已而詳定所言：「古者天子祭宗廟，有堂事焉，有室事焉。

translations.literal: Later the commission for determining ritual texts stated: "In antiquity when the Son of Heaven sacrificed at the ancestral temple, there were hall rites and chamber rites.
translations.idiomatic: Later the ritual commission stated: "In antiquity when the Son of Heaven worshipped at the ancestral temple, there were hall rites and chamber rites.

sentences.zh: 按《禮》，祝延屍入奧，灌後乃出延牲，延屍主出於室，坐於堂 上，始祖南面，昭在東，穆在西，乃行朝踐之禮，是堂事也。

translations.literal: According to the Rites, the invoker led the corpse into the inner recess; after libation the victim was brought out; the spirit tablet was brought from the chamber and seated in the hall; the founding ancestor faced south, zhao to the east and mu to the west, and the court audience rite was performed—this was the hall rite.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Rites, the invoker led the representative corpse into the inner recess; after libation the victim was presented; the spirit tablet was brought from the chamber to the hall; the founding ancestor faced south with zhao east and mu west, and the court audience rite was performed—the hall rite.

sentences.zh: 設饌於堂，復延主入室，始祖東面，昭南穆北，徙常上之饌於室中，乃行饋食之禮，是室事也。

translations.literal: Food was set in the hall, then the tablet was brought back into the chamber; the founding ancestor faced east, zhao south and mu north; the food from the hall was moved into the chamber, and the feeding rite was performed—this was the chamber rite.
translations.idiomatic: Food was set in the hall, then the tablet returned to the chamber; the founding ancestor faced east with zhao south and mu north; the hall offerings were moved inside, and the feeding rite was performed—the chamber rite.

sentences.zh: 請每行 大祫，堂上設南面之位，室中設東面之位。

translations.literal: We request that at each great xia a south-facing seat be set in the hall and an east-facing seat in the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that at each great xia a south-facing seat be set in the hall and an east-facing seat in the chamber.

sentences.zh: 」禮部言：「合食之禮，始祖東面、昭南穆北者，本室中之位也。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Rites stated: "In the joint feast rite, the founding ancestor facing east with zhao south and mu north is originally the seating of the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: " The Ministry of Rites replied: "In the joint feast, the founding ancestor east-facing with zhao south and mu north is the chamber arrangement.

sentences.zh: 今設位戶外，祖宗昭、穆別為幄次，殆非合食之義。

translations.literal: Now seats are set outside the doors, with ancestors, zhao, and mu in separate canopies—this scarcely accords with the meaning of a joint feast.
translations.idiomatic: Setting seats outside with ancestors, zhao, and mu in separate canopies scarcely matches a true joint feast.

sentences.zh: 請 自今祫享，即前楹通設帳幕，以應室中之位。」

translations.literal: We request that from now on at xia offerings, curtains be set continuously before the front pillars to correspond to the chamber seating."
translations.idiomatic: From the next xia onward, we ask that curtains be hung continuously before the front pillars to match the chamber seating."

sentences.zh: 大觀四年，議禮局請：「每大祫，堂上設南面之位，室中設東南之位，始祖南面則昭穆東西相向，始祖東面則昭穆南北相向，以應古義。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daguan, the Bureau for Deliberating Ritual requested: "At each great xia, set a south-facing seat in the hall and a southeast-facing seat in the chamber; when the founding ancestor faces south, zhao and mu face each other east and west; when the founding ancestor faces east, zhao and mu face each other north and south, to accord with ancient meaning.
translations.idiomatic: In Daguan 4 the Bureau for Deliberating Ritual proposed: "At each great xia, set a south-facing seat in the hall and a southeast-facing seat in the chamber—when the founding ancestor faces south, zhao and mu face east and west; when he faces east, zhao and mu face north and south, in accord with antiquity.

sentences.zh: 」又請：「陳瑞物及代國之寶與貢物可出而陳者，並令有司依嘉祐、元豐詔旨，凡親祠太廟準此。

translations.literal: " They also requested: "Auspicious objects, treasures of successive dynasties, and tribute items fit for display should all be ordered displayed by the relevant offices according to the edicts of Jiayou and Yuanfeng; all personal worship at the Imperial Ancestral Temple should follow this."
translations.idiomatic: " They also asked that auspicious objects, dynastic treasures, and displayable tribute items be set out by the relevant offices per the Jiayou and Yuanfeng edicts, with all personal worship at the imperial ancestral temple following the same rule."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 南渡之後，有祫而無禘。

translations.literal: After the crossing to the south, there were xia sacrifices but no di.
translations.idiomatic: After the court moved south, xia rites were held but not di.

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎二年，祫享於洪州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan of Emperor Gaozong, a xia offering was held at Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 2 under Emperor Gaozong, a xia rite was held at Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年，祫享於溫州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing, a xia offering was held at Wen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 2, a xia rite was held at Wen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時儀文草創，奉遷祖宗及祧廟神主、別廟神主，各設幄合食於太廟。

translations.literal: At that time ritual texts were newly devised; the ancestors and the spirit tablets of the distant shrine and separate temples were all brought, each with a canopy set up for joint feast at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual forms were then newly devised: ancestral tablets from the main, distant, and separate shrines were brought, each under its own canopy, for a joint feast in the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 始祖東向，昭、穆以次南北相向。

translations.literal: The founding ancestor faced east; zhao and mu in order faced each other north and south.
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor faced east; zhao and mu in succession faced one another north and south.

sentences.zh: 五年，吏部員外郎董弅言：「臣聞戎、祀，國之大事，而宗廟之祭，又祀之大者也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Dong Bian stated: "Your subject has heard that war and sacrifice are great affairs of state, and sacrifice at the ancestral temple is the greatest of sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, Vice Director of Personnel Dong Bian memorialized: "I have heard that war and sacrifice are the state's greatest affairs, and ancestral temple worship the greatest of sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 大祀，禘祫為重，祫大禘小，則袷為莫大焉。

translations.literal: Among great sacrifices, di and xia are weightiest; xia is greater and di lesser, so xia is the greatest of all.
translations.idiomatic: Among great sacrifices di and xia weigh most heavily; xia is greater than di, so xia is supreme.

sentences.zh: 今戎事方殷，祭祀之禮未暇遍 舉，然事有違經戾古，上不當天地神祇之意，下未合億兆黎庶之心，特出於一時大臣好勝之臆說，而行之六十年未有知其非者。

translations.literal: Now warfare is pressing and sacrificial rites cannot all be performed, yet there are matters that violate the classics and oppose antiquity, failing above to accord with Heaven, Earth, and the spirits and below to satisfy the hearts of the myriad people—arising solely from a chief minister's contentious private opinion of the moment, practiced for sixty years without anyone knowing it was wrong.
translations.idiomatic: War now presses and not every sacrifice can be performed, yet some practices violate the classics and antiquity—offending Heaven, Earth, and the spirits above and the people below—born solely from one minister's contentious private notion and followed for sixty years without recognition of error.

sentences.zh: 顧雖治兵禦戎之際，正厥違誤，宜不 可緩。

translations.literal: Yet even amid training troops and resisting the enemy, correcting these errors should not be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Even amid military preparations, correcting these errors cannot wait.

sentences.zh: 仰惟太祖受天明命，混一區宇，即其功德所起，宜祇享以正東向之尊。

translations.literal: Looking up, Taizu received Heaven's clear Mandate and unified the realm; from the source of his merit and virtue, he should be worshipped with the corrected honor of the east-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu received Heaven's clear Mandate and unified the realm; as the source of dynastic merit, he should receive worship with the corrected east-facing honor.

sentences.zh: 逮至仁宗，親行祫享，嘗議太祖東向，用昭正統之緒。

translations.literal: By the time of Renzong, who personally performed the xia offering, Taizu's east-facing seat was once debated to display the legitimacy of the orthodox succession.
translations.idiomatic: By Emperor Renzong's time, when he performed the xia in person, Taizu's east-facing seat was debated to display the legitimacy of the orthodox line.

sentences.zh: 當時在廷之臣，僉謂自古必以受 命之祖乃居東向之位，本朝太祖乃受命之君，若論七廟之次，有僖祖以降四廟在上，當時大祫，止列昭穆而虛東向，蓋終不敢以非受命之祖而居之也。

translations.literal: The ministers then at court all said that from antiquity only the ancestor who received the Mandate could occupy the east-facing seat; in our dynasty Taizu was the Mandate-receiving sovereign; if one considers the order of the seven temples, four temples from Emperor Xi downward stood above him; at the great xia of that time only zhao and mu were arrayed and the east-facing seat left vacant—ultimately they dared not let one who had not received the Mandate occupy it.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers at court agreed that only the Mandate-receiving ancestor could take the east-facing seat; Taizu was our Mandate-receiving sovereign; yet with four shrines from Emperor Xi above him in the seven-temple order, the great xia arrayed only zhao and mu and left the east-facing seat empty—they dared not seat a non-Mandate ancestor there.

sentences.zh: 暨熙寧之初， 僖祖以世次當祧，禮官韓維等據經有請，適王安石用事，奮其臆說，乃俾章衡建議，尊僖祖為始祖，肇居東向。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining, Emperor Xi by generational order should have been removed to the distant shrine; ritual officials Han Wei and others petitioned on canonical grounds; just then Wang Anshi held power, advanced his private theory, and had Zhang Heng propose honoring Emperor Xi as founding ancestor and first occupying the east-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Xining, Emperor Xi should by generational order have moved to the distant shrine; ritual officials Han Wei and others petitioned on canonical grounds; Wang Anshi then held power, advanced his private theory, and had Zhang Heng propose honoring Emperor Xi as founding ancestor with the east-facing seat.

sentences.zh: 馮京奏謂士大夫以太祖不得東向為恨，安石肆言以折 之。

translations.literal: Feng Jing memorialized that scholar-officials resented Taizu not facing east; Anshi spoke freely to refute them.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Jing reported that scholar-officials resented Taizu not facing east; Anshi spoke out sharply to refute them.

sentences.zh: 已而又欲罷太祖郊配，神宗以太祖開基受命，不許，安石終不以為然。

translations.literal: Later he also wished to abolish Taizu's suburban pairing; Shenzong, holding that Taizu founded the dynasty and received the Mandate, did not permit it; Anshi never agreed.
translations.idiomatic: He later also sought to end Taizu's suburban pairing; Shenzong, holding that Taizu founded the dynasty and received the Mandate, refused; Anshi never accepted the refusal.

sentences.zh: 元祐之初，翼祖既祧，正合典禮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, Emperor Yi had already been moved to the distant shrine, which fully accorded with canonical ritual.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Yuanyou, Emperor Yi had already moved to the distant shrine—fully in accord with ritual.

sentences.zh: 至於崇寧，宣祖當祧，適蔡京用事，一遵安石之術，乃 建言請立九廟，自我作古，其已祧翼祖、宣祖並即依舊。

translations.literal: By Chongning, Emperor Xuan should have been removed to the distant shrine; just then Cai Jing held power and followed Anshi's method entirely, proposing to establish nine temples, making antiquity anew; the already removed Emperors Yi and Xuan were likewise kept as before.
translations.idiomatic: By Chongning, Emperor Xuan should have moved to the distant shrine; Cai Jing then held power, followed Anshi's method, and proposed nine temples, making antiquity anew; the already removed Emperors Yi and Xuan were kept in place.

sentences.zh: 循沿至今，太祖尚居第四室，遇大祫處昭穆之列。

translations.literal: Following this to the present, Taizu still occupies the fourth chamber; at great xia he is placed among the zhao and mu.
translations.idiomatic: Down to the present Taizu still occupies the fourth chamber; at great xia he stands among the zhao and mu.

sentences.zh: 今若正太祖東向之尊，委合《禮經》。」

translations.literal: If now Taizu's east-facing honor is corrected, it will truly accord with the Ritual Canon."
translations.idiomatic: To restore Taizu's east-facing honor now would truly accord with the Ritual Canon."

sentences.zh: 太 常寺丞王普又言：「弅所奏深得禮意，而其言尚有未盡。

translations.literal: Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wang Pu also stated: "Bian's memorial deeply accords with ritual intent, yet his words do not exhaust the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Director Wang Pu of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices added: "Bian's memorial grasps ritual intent well, yet does not exhaust the matter.

sentences.zh: 臣竊以古者廟製異宮，則太祖居中，而群廟列其左右；

translations.literal: Your subject holds that in antiquity when temples were separate halls, Taizu stood at the center and the group of temples were arrayed to his left and right;
translations.idiomatic: I hold that when temples were separate halls, Taizu stood at the center with the other shrines to left and right;

sentences.zh: 後世廟製同堂，則太祖居右，而諸室皆列其左。

translations.literal: in later ages when temples shared one hall, Taizu stood on the right and all chambers were arrayed to his left.
translations.idiomatic: when temples shared one hall, Taizu stood on the right and all chambers to his left.

sentences.zh: 古者 祫享，朝踐於堂，則太祖南向，而昭穆位於東西；

translations.literal: In antiquity at xia offerings, the court audience rite was in the hall; Taizu faced south and zhao and mu were placed east and west;
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity at xia, the court audience rite was in the hall: Taizu faced south with zhao and mu east and west;

sentences.zh: 饋食於室，則太祖東向，而昭穆位於南北。

translations.literal: feeding was in the chamber; Taizu faced east and zhao and mu were placed north and south.
translations.idiomatic: feeding was in the chamber: Taizu faced east with zhao and mu north and south.

sentences.zh: 後世祫享一於堂上，而用室中之位，故唯以東向為太祖之尊焉。

translations.literal: In later ages xia offerings were all in the hall yet used chamber seating; therefore only east-facing marks Taizu's honor.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages held xia entirely in the hall but used chamber seating—hence only east-facing marks Taizu's honor.

sentences.zh: 若夫群 廟迭毀，而太祖不遷，則其禮尚矣。

translations.literal: As for the group of temples being removed in turn while Taizu is not moved, that ritual is still honored.
translations.idiomatic: When subsidiary shrines are removed in turn while Taizu is never moved, that ritual principle still stands.

sentences.zh: 臣故知太祖即廟之始祖，是為廟號，非諡號也。

translations.literal: Your subject therefore knows that Taizu is the founding ancestor of the temple—this is a temple title, not a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore know that Taizu is the temple's founding ancestor—a temple title, not a posthumous epithet.

sentences.zh: 惟我太宗嗣服之初，太祖廟號已定，雖更累朝，世次猶近，每於祫享，必虛東向 之位，以其非太祖必不可居也。

translations.literal: Only at the beginning of our Taizong's succession, Taizu's temple title was already fixed; though many reigns passed, the generations were still near; at each xia the east-facing seat was left vacant, for none but Taizu could occupy it.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Taizong's reign Taizu's temple title was already fixed; though reigns passed, generations were still near; at each xia the east-facing seat was left empty—only Taizu could occupy it.

sentences.zh: 迨至熙寧，又尊僖祖為廟之始祖，百世不遷，祫享東向，而太祖常居穆位，則名實舛矣。

translations.literal: By Xining, Emperor Xi was again honored as the temple's founding ancestor, never removed for a hundred generations, facing east at xia while Taizu constantly stood in the mu position—name and reality were at odds.
translations.idiomatic: By Xining, Emperor Xi was again honored as founding ancestor, never removed, facing east at xia while Taizu stood in the mu line—name and reality diverged.

sentences.zh: 倘以熙寧之禮為是，僖祖當稱太祖，而太祖 當改廟號。

translations.literal: If the Xining ritual were correct, Emperor Xi should be called Taizu and Taizu should change his temple title.
translations.idiomatic: If Xining ritual were correct, Emperor Xi should be called Taizu and Taizu should change his temple title.

sentences.zh: 然則太祖之名不正，前日之失大矣。

translations.literal: Then Taizu's name would not be correct, and the error of earlier days would be great.
translations.idiomatic: Then Taizu's title would be wrong and the earlier error grave.

sentences.zh: 今宜奉太祖神主居第一室，永為廟之始祖。

translations.literal: Now Taizu's spirit tablet should be placed in the first chamber, forever the temple's founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's tablet should now occupy the first chamber as the temple's permanent founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 每歲五享、告朔、薦新，止於七廟。

translations.literal: Each year's five offerings, new-moon announcements, and new-harvest offerings should be limited to the seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: The five annual offerings, new-moon announcements, and new-harvest offerings should be limited to the seven temples.

sentences.zh: 三年一祫，則太祖正東向之位。

translations.literal: Every three years at xia, Taizu should take the corrected east-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years at xia, Taizu should take the corrected east-facing seat.

sentences.zh: 太 宗、仁宗、神宗南向為昭，真宗、英宗、哲宗北向為穆。

translations.literal: Taizong, Renzong, and Shenzong facing south as zhao; Zhenzong, Yingzong, and Zhezong facing north as mu.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, Renzong, and Shenzong south-facing as zhao; Zhenzong, Yingzong, and Zhezong north-facing as mu.

sentences.zh: 五年一禘，則迎宣祖神主享於太廟，而以太祖配焉。

translations.literal: Every five years at di, welcome Emperor Xuan's spirit tablet to be worshipped at the Imperial Ancestral Temple with Taizu as his paired consort.
translations.idiomatic: Every five years at di, welcome Emperor Xuan's tablet to the imperial ancestral temple with Taizu as paired sovereign.

sentences.zh: 如是，則宗廟之事盡合《禮經》，無復前日之失矣。

translations.literal: Thus ancestral temple affairs would fully accord with the Ritual Canon and the errors of earlier days would be no more.
translations.idiomatic: Then ancestral affairs would fully accord with the Ritual Canon and past errors end.

sentences.zh: 」 上曰：「太祖皇帝開基創業，始受天命，祫享宜居東向之位。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Emperor Taizu founded the dynasty and first received the Mandate; at xia offerings he should occupy the east-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Emperor Taizu founded the dynasty and first received the Mandate; at xia he should occupy the east-facing seat.

sentences.zh: 」宰相趙鼎等奏曰：「三昭三穆，與太祖之廟而七，載在《禮經》，無可疑者。」

translations.literal: " Chief minister Zhao Ding and others memorialized: "Three zhao and three mu, with Taizu's temple making seven, are recorded in the Ritual Canon—there is no doubt."
translations.idiomatic: " Chief minister Zhao Ding and others replied: "Three zhao and three mu with Taizu's shrine make seven—recorded in the Ritual Canon, beyond doubt."

sentences.zh: 紹熙五 年九月，太常少卿曾三復亦言：請祧宣祖，就正太祖東向之位，其言甚切。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Shaoxi, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zeng Sanfu also stated: Request removal of Emperor Xuan to the distant shrine and correction of Taizu's east-facing seat—his words were very earnest.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Shaoxi 5, Vice Director Zeng Sanfu of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices likewise petitioned to remove Emperor Xuan to the distant shrine and restore Taizu's east-facing seat—his words were urgent.

sentences.zh: 既而吏部尚書鄭僑等亦乞因大行祔廟之際，定宗廟萬世之禮，慰太祖在天之靈，破熙寧不 經之論。

translations.literal: Then Minister of Personnel Zheng Qiao and others also begged that on the occasion of enshrining the late emperor in the temple, the ancestral rites for ten thousand generations be fixed, comforting Taizu's spirit in Heaven and refuting the uncanonical theory of Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Then Minister of Personnel Zheng Qiao and others asked that when the late emperor was enshrined, the ancestral rites for all generations be settled, comforting Taizu's spirit and refuting Xining's uncanonical theory.

sentences.zh: 今太祖為始祖，則太宗為昭，真宗為穆，自是而下以至孝宗，四昭四穆與太祖之廟而九。

translations.literal: Now with Taizu as founding ancestor, Taizong is zhao and Zhenzong mu; from there down to Xiaozong, four zhao and four mu with Taizu's temple make nine.
translations.idiomatic: With Taizu as founding ancestor, Taizong is zhao and Zhenzong mu; down to Xiaozong, four zhao and four mu with Taizu's shrine make nine.

sentences.zh: 上參古禮，而不廢崇寧九廟之制，於義為允。

translations.literal: The emperor consulted ancient ritual yet did not abolish the nine-temple system of Chongning—in principle this was acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted ancient ritual without abolishing Chongning's nine-temple system—a reasonable compromise.

sentences.zh: 又言：「治平四年， 僖祖祧遷，藏在西夾室。

translations.literal: They also stated: "In the fourth year of Zhiping, Emperor Xi's tablet was moved to the distant shrine and stored in the west side chamber.
translations.idiomatic: They also noted that in Zhiping 4 Emperor Xi's tablet was moved to the distant shrine and stored in the west side chamber.

sentences.zh: 至熙寧五年，王安石以私意使章衡等議，乃復祔僖祖以為始祖，又將推以配天，欲罷太祖郊配。

translations.literal: By the fifth year of Xining, Wang Anshi from private intent had Zhang Heng and others deliberate, again enshrining Emperor Xi as founding ancestor and further proposing him for Heaven pairing, wishing to abolish Taizu's suburban pairing.
translations.idiomatic: By Xining 5, Wang Anshi from private intent had Zhang Heng and others deliberate, re-enshrining Emperor Xi as founding ancestor and proposing him for Heaven pairing while seeking to end Taizu's suburban pairing.

sentences.zh: 韓維、司馬光等力爭，而安石主其說愈堅。

translations.literal: Han Wei, Sima Guang, and others argued forcefully, while Anshi held to his view ever more firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wei, Sima Guang, and others argued forcefully; Anshi held ever more firmly to his view.

sentences.zh: 孫固慮其罷太祖配天，建議以僖祖權居東向之位。

translations.literal: Sun Gu, fearing abolition of Taizu's Heaven pairing, proposed that Emperor Xi provisionally occupy the east-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Gu, fearing abolition of Taizu's Heaven pairing, proposed that Emperor Xi provisionally take the east-facing seat.

sentences.zh: 既曰權居，則當厘正明矣。

translations.literal: Since it was called provisional occupancy, it should now be clearly corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Since it was provisional, it should now be clearly corrected.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: " An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered this followed.

sentences.zh: 閏十月，權禮部侍郎許及之言：「僖、順、翼、宣四祖，為太 祖之祖考，所遷之主，恐不得藏於子孫之廟。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month, Acting Vice Minister of Rites Xu Jiyan stated: "The four ancestors Xi, Shun, Yi, and Xuan were Taizu's forefathers; the tablets moved to the distant shrine perhaps may not be stored in their descendants' temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, Acting Vice Minister of Rites Xu Jiyan argued: "The four ancestors Xi, Shun, Yi, and Xuan were Taizu's forefathers; their distant-shrine tablets perhaps should not be stored in descendants' temple.

sentences.zh: 今順、翼二祖藏於西夾室，實居太廟太祖之右。

translations.literal: Now Emperors Shun and Yi are stored in the west side chamber, actually to the right of Taizu in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Emperors Shun and Yi are now stored in the west side chamber—to the right of Taizu in the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 遇祫享，則於夾室之前，設位以昭穆焉。

translations.literal: When a xia offering occurs, seats are set before the side chambers according to zhao and mu.
translations.idiomatic: At xia, seats are set before the side chambers according to zhao and mu.

sentences.zh: 」於是詔有司集議，吏部尚書 兼侍讀鄭僑等言：「僖祖當用唐興聖之制，立為別廟，順祖、翼祖、宣祖之主皆祔藏焉。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict ordered the offices to assemble for deliberation; Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Palace Reader Zheng Qiao and others stated: "Emperor Xi should follow Tang's system for Emperor Xingsheng, established as a separate temple, with the tablets of Emperors Shun, Yi, and Xuan all enshrined and stored there.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered deliberation; Minister of Personnel and Palace Reader Zheng Qiao and others argued: "Emperor Xi should follow Tang's Xingsheng precedent as a separate shrine, with the tablets of Emperors Shun, Yi, and Xuan enshrined there.

sentences.zh: 如此，則僖祖自居別廟之尊，三祖不祔子孫之廟。

translations.literal: Thus Emperor Xi would himself hold the honor of a separate temple, and the three ancestors would not be enshrined in their descendants' temple.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Emperor Xi would hold separate-shrine honor and the three ancestors would not stand in descendants' temple.

sentences.zh: 自漢、魏以來，太祖而 上，毀廟之主皆不合食，今遇祫，則即廟而享，於禮尤稱。

translations.literal: From Han and Wei onward, tablets above Taizu from removed temples have never shared the feast; now at xia they would be worshipped at their own temples—especially fitting in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: From Han and Wei onward, tablets above Taizu from removed shrines never shared the feast; at xia they would be worshipped at their own shrines—especially fitting.

sentences.zh: 」諸儒如樓鑰、陳傅良皆以為可，詔從之。

translations.literal: " Confucian scholars such as Lou Yue and Chen Fuliang all held this acceptable, and an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " Scholars such as Lou Yue and Chen Fuliang approved; the emperor ordered it followed.

sentences.zh: 時朱熹在講筵，獨入議狀，條其不可者四，大略 云：「準尚書吏部牒，集議四祖祧主宜有所歸。

translations.literal: At that time Zhu Xi was at the lecture seat and alone submitted a deliberation document, listing four impossibilities, in summary saying: "According to the Ministry of Personnel dispatch, deliberation is convened on where the four ancestors' distant-shrine tablets should be placed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi, then at the lecture seat, alone submitted a deliberation listing four objections, in summary: "Per the Ministry of Personnel dispatch, deliberation is convened on where the four ancestors' distant-shrine tablets should go.

sentences.zh: 今詳群議雖多，而皆有可疑。

translations.literal: Now though the many proposals are detailed, all are doubtful.
translations.idiomatic: Though many proposals have been offered, all are doubtful.

sentences.zh: 若曰藏之夾室，則是以祖宗之主下藏於子孫之夾室。

translations.literal: If they say store them in side chambers, this is to place the ancestors' tablets below in their descendants' side chambers.
translations.idiomatic: To store them in side chambers is to place ancestors' tablets below in descendants' side chambers.

sentences.zh: 至於祫祭，設幄於夾室之前，則亦 不得謂之祫。

translations.literal: As for xia sacrifice, setting canopies before the side chambers cannot be called xia.
translations.idiomatic: Setting canopies before side chambers at xia cannot be called xia.

sentences.zh: 欲別立一廟，則喪事即遠，有毀無立。

translations.literal: Wishing to establish a separate temple, the mourning is already distant—there is removal but no establishment.
translations.idiomatic: To establish a separate shrine: mourning is long past—removal is allowed, establishment is not.

sentences.zh: 欲藏之天興殿，則宗廟、原廟不可相雜。

translations.literal: Wishing to store them in the Hall of Heavenly Prosperity, ancestral temple and original temple must not be mixed.
translations.idiomatic: To store them in the Hall of Heavenly Prosperity mixes ancestral and original shrines improperly.

sentences.zh: 議者皆知其不安，特以其心欲尊奉太祖三年一袷時暫東向之故，其實無 益於太祖之尊，而徒使僖祖、太祖兩朝威靈，相與校強弱於冥冥之中。

translations.literal: Deliberators all know this is unsound, yet solely because in their hearts they wish to honor Taizu by having him face east temporarily at the triennial xia—it in fact does not benefit Taizu's honor but only makes the numinous authority of Emperor Xi and Taizong's reigns contend for strength in the unseen realm.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberators know this is unsound, yet wish only to honor Taizu by having him face east temporarily at triennial xia—it does not truly honor Taizu but sets the numinous authority of Emperor Xi and Taizu contending in the unseen realm.

sentences.zh: 今但以太祖當日追尊帝號之令而默推之，則知今日太祖在天之靈，必有所不忍而不敢當矣。

translations.literal: Now if one silently infers from the edict of Taizu's day posthumously honoring his imperial title, one knows that today Taizu's spirit in Heaven must have what it cannot bear and dare not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Infer silently from Taizu's own day the edict posthumously honoring his title, and one knows Taizu's spirit in Heaven must find this unbearable and dare not accept it.

sentences.zh: 又 況僖祖祧主遷於治平，不過數年，神宗復奉以為始祖，已為得禮之正而合於人心，所謂『有其舉之，莫敢廢者』。

translations.literal: Moreover, Emperor Xi's distant-shrine tablet was moved in Zhiping; within a few years Shenzong again honored him as founding ancestor—already the correct ritual and accord with human hearts, as the saying goes, 'When there is one who initiates it, none dare abolish it.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Emperor Xi's tablet was moved in Zhiping; within a few years Shenzong again honored him as founding ancestor—already correct ritual and popular assent: 'When one initiates it, none dare abolish it.'

sentences.zh: 」又言：「當以僖祖為始祖，如周之後稷，太祖如 周之文王，太宗如周之武王，與仁宗之廟，皆萬世不祧；

translations.literal: " He also stated: "Emperor Xi should be taken as founding ancestor, like Zhou's Hou Ji; Taizu like Zhou's King Wen; Taizong like Zhou's King Wu; with Renzong's temple—all never removed for ten thousand generations;
translations.idiomatic: " He also argued: "Emperor Xi should be founding ancestor, like Zhou's Hou Ji; Taizu like King Wen; Taizong like King Wu; with Renzong's shrine—all never removed for ten thousand generations;

sentences.zh: 昭穆而次，以至高宗之廟亦萬世不祧。

translations.literal: zhao and mu in succession, down to Gaozong's temple also never removed for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: zhao and mu in succession, down to Gaozong's shrine also never removed.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「元祐大儒程頤以為王安石言『僖祖不當祧』，復立廟為得 禮。

translations.literal: " He also stated: "The great Ru scholar Cheng Yi of Yuanyou held that Wang Anshi's saying 'Emperor Xi should not be removed to the distant shrine' and re-establishing his temple was obtaining ritual.
translations.idiomatic: " He also noted that the great scholar Cheng Yi of Yuanyou held Wang Anshi right that 'Emperor Xi should not be removed' and that re-establishing his shrine accorded with ritual.

sentences.zh: 竊詳頤之議論與安石不同，至論此事則深服之，足以見義理人心之所同，固有不約而合者。

translations.literal: Your subject has examined in detail that Yi's deliberations differ from Anshi's, yet on this matter he deeply approved—enough to show that principle and human hearts agree, and there are indeed those who accord without prior agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's views differ from Anshi's on most matters, yet on this he deeply approved—showing that principle and popular sentiment can coincide without prior agreement.

sentences.zh: 特以司馬光、韓維之徒皆是大賢，人所敬信，其議偶不出此，而安石 乃以變亂穿鑿得罪於公議，故欲堅守二賢之說，並安石所當取者而盡廢之。

translations.literal: Only because Sima Guang, Han Wei, and their like are all great worthies whom people respect and trust, and their deliberations happened not to come to this, while Anshi offended public opinion by changing and forcing interpretations—therefore they wish to hold fast to the two worthies' views and abolish entirely even what Anshi should have taken.
translations.idiomatic: Only because Sima Guang, Han Wei, and their like are revered worthies whose views happened not to reach this conclusion, while Anshi offended public opinion by forced innovation—opponents wish to hold fast to the two worthies and reject even what Anshi got right.

sentences.zh: 今以程頤之說考之，則是非可判矣。」

translations.literal: Now examining by Cheng Yi's view, right and wrong can be judged."
translations.idiomatic: Examined by Cheng Yi's view, right and wrong are clear."

sentences.zh: 時宰臣趙汝愚既以安石之論為非，異議者懼其軋己，藉以求勝，事竟不行。

translations.literal: At that time chief minister Zhao Ruyu already held Anshi's theory wrong; those who differed feared he would overpower them and used this to seek victory—the matter in the end was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Chief minister Zhao Ruyu already rejected Anshi's theory; opponents feared being overruled and used the dispute to prevail—the matter was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 熹時以得罪，遺汝愚書曰：「相公以宗子入輔王室，而無故輕納妄議，拆祖宗之廟以快 其私，欲望神靈降歆，垂休錫羨，以永國祚於無窮，其可得乎？

translations.literal: Xi, then under censure, sent Ruyu a letter saying: "The chief minister entered to assist the royal house as a clansman, yet without cause lightly accepted reckless proposals, dismantling the ancestors' temple to satisfy private ends—can one desire the spirits to descend with favor, bestow blessing and grace, and extend the state's fortune without end?"
translations.idiomatic: Xi, then under censure, wrote Ruyu: "You entered as a clansman to assist the throne, yet without cause accepted reckless proposals and dismantled the ancestral temple for private ends—can you expect the spirits' favor and endless dynastic fortune?"

sentences.zh: 」時太廟殿已為十二室，故孝宗升祔，而東室尚虛。

translations.literal: " At that time the ancestral temple hall already had twelve chambers; therefore when Xiaozong was enshrined, the east chamber was still vacant.
translations.idiomatic: " The ancestral hall already had twelve chambers; when Xiaozong was enshrined, the east chamber remained vacant.

sentences.zh: 熹以為非所以祝延壽康之意，深不然之，因自劾 不堪言語侍從之選，乞追奪待制，不許。

translations.literal: Xi held that this was not the intent of praying for long life and health, deeply disapproved, and therefore impeached himself as unfit for selection as attendant in discourse, begging revocation of his academician appointment—not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Xi held this contrary to prayers for the emperor's long life, deeply disapproved, and impeached himself as unfit for court discourse, begging revocation of his academician title—refused.

sentences.zh: 及光宗祔廟，遂復為九世十二室。

translations.literal: When Guangzong was enshrined in the temple, it again became nine generations and twelve chambers.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong was enshrined, the arrangement again became nine generations in twelve chambers.

sentences.zh: 蓋自昌陵祔廟，逾二百年而後正太祖之位。

translations.literal: From the enshrinement from the Changling mausoleum, more than two hundred years passed before Taizu's seat was corrected.
translations.idiomatic: From the enshrinement of the mausoleum tablets in the temple, more than two centuries passed before Taizu's seat was finally corrected.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年四月，禮部太常寺言：「已於太廟之 西，別建僖祖廟，及告遷僖、順、翼、宣帝後神主詣僖祖廟奉安。
