translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Qingyuan, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "A separate temple for Emperor Xi has already been built west of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and announcement has been made to move the spirit tablets of Emperors Xi, Shun, Yi, and Xuan and their consorts to the temple of Emperor Xi for installation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Qingyuan 2, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "A separate shrine for Emperor Xi has been built west of the imperial ancestral temple, and the tablets of Emperors Xi, Shun, Yi, and Xuan and their consorts are to be moved there for installation.

sentences.zh: 所有今年孟冬祫享，先詣四祖廟室行禮，次詣太廟，逐幄次行禮。」

translations.literal: For this year's early-winter xia offering, rites will first be performed at the four ancestors' temple chambers, then at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, performing rites at each canopy in turn."
translations.idiomatic: For this year's early-winter xia rite, ceremonies will first be held at the four ancestors' shrine chambers, then at the imperial ancestral temple, with rites at each canopy in turn."

sentences.zh: 理宗紹定四年九 月丙戌，京師大火，延及太廟。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the ninth month of the fourth year of Shaoding of Emperor Lizong, a great fire broke out in the capital and spread to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the ninth month of Shaoding 4 under Emperor Lizong, a great fire broke out in the capital and spread to the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿度正言：「伏見近世大儒侍講朱熹詳考古禮，尚論宗廟之制，畫而為圖，其說甚備。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Du Zheng stated: "Your subject has seen that the great Ru scholar of recent times, Lecturer Zhu Xi, examined ancient ritual in detail, discussed the regulation of the ancestral temple, drew it as a diagram, and his exposition is very complete.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Du Zheng of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "The great scholar Lecturer Zhu Xi of recent times examined ancient ritual in detail, discussed ancestral temple regulation, drew diagrams, and his exposition is thorough.

sentences.zh: 然其為製，務效於古而頗更本朝之制， 故學士大夫皆有異論，遂不能行。

translations.literal: Yet in his design he strove to imitate antiquity and considerably altered our dynasty's regulation; therefore scholar-officials all had differing views, and it could not be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his design strove to imitate antiquity and altered our dynasty's arrangements considerably; scholar-officials disagreed, and it was never implemented.

sentences.zh: 今天降災異，火發民家，延及宗廟，舉而行之，莫此時為宜。

translations.literal: Now Heaven has sent a calamitous sign: fire broke out in people's homes and spread to the ancestral temple—to implement it, no time is more fitting than this.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has now sent a portent: fire spread from homes to the ancestral temple—to implement his plan, no moment is more fitting.

sentences.zh: 臣於向來備聞其說，今備員禮寺，適當此變，若遂隱默，則為有負， 謹為二說以獻。

translations.literal: Your subject has long heard his exposition in full; now serving as a supernumerary in the ritual office, just at this change—if I remain silent, I would be failing in duty; I respectfully offer two proposals for submission.
translations.idiomatic: I have long heard his views in full; now serving in the ritual office at this crisis, silence would be a failure of duty—I respectfully offer two proposals.

sentences.zh: 其一，純用朱熹之說，謂本朝廟製未合於古，因畫為圖，謂僖祖如周後稷，當為本朝始祖。

translations.literal: The first is to use Zhu Xi's view entirely, holding that our dynasty's temple design does not accord with antiquity; he drew it as a diagram, holding that Emperor Xi is like Zhou's Hou Ji and should be our dynasty's founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: The first is to adopt Zhu Xi's view entirely: our temple design does not accord with antiquity; he drew diagrams holding that Emperor Xi, like Zhou's Hou Ji, should be our founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 夫尊僖祖以為始祖，是乃順太祖皇帝之孝心也。

translations.literal: To honor Emperor Xi as founding ancestor is to follow Emperor Taizu's filial intent.
translations.idiomatic: To honor Emperor Xi as founding ancestor follows Emperor Taizu's filial intent.

sentences.zh: 始祖之廟 居於中，左昭右穆各為一廟，門皆南向，位皆東向。

translations.literal: The founding ancestor's temple stands at the center; zhao to the left and mu to the right each have a separate temple; all gates face south and all seats face east.
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor's shrine stands at the center; zhao left and mu right each have a separate shrine; all gates face south and all seats face east.

sentences.zh: 祧廟之主藏於始祖之廟夾室，昭常為昭，穆常為穆，自不相亂。

translations.literal: Tablets from the distant shrine are stored in the side chambers of the founding ancestor's temple; zhao always remains zhao and mu always mu, never confused with one another.
translations.idiomatic: Distant-shrine tablets are stored in the founding ancestor's side chambers; zhao remains zhao and mu mu, never confused.

sentences.zh: 三年合食，則並出祧廟之主，合享於始祖之廟。

translations.literal: At the triennial joint feast, tablets from the distant shrine are all brought out and jointly worshipped at the founding ancestor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: At the triennial joint feast, distant-shrine tablets are all brought out for joint worship at the founding ancestor's shrine.

sentences.zh: 始祖東向，群昭之主皆位北而南向，群穆之主皆位南而北向。

translations.literal: The founding ancestor faces east; all zhao tablets are placed to the north facing south, and all mu tablets to the south facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor faces east; all zhao tablets stand north facing south, all mu south facing north.

sentences.zh: 昭穆既分，尊卑以定。

translations.literal: Once zhao and mu are divided, superior and inferior are fixed.
translations.idiomatic: With zhao and mu divided, rank and precedence are fixed.

sentences.zh: 其說合於古而宜於今，盡美盡善。

translations.literal: This exposition accords with antiquity and suits the present—altogether beautiful and good.
translations.idiomatic: This view accords with antiquity and suits the present—altogether sound.

sentences.zh: 舉而行之，祖宗在天之靈必歆享於此，而垂祐 於無窮也。

translations.literal: If implemented, the ancestors' spirits in Heaven will surely delight in this and bestow blessing without end.
translations.idiomatic: Implemented, the ancestors' spirits in Heaven will surely delight in this and bestow endless blessing.

sentences.zh: 其一說，則因本朝之制，而參以朱熹之說。

translations.literal: The second proposal follows our dynasty's regulation while incorporating Zhu Xi's views.
translations.idiomatic: The second proposal follows our dynasty's arrangements while incorporating Zhu Xi's views.

sentences.zh: 蓋本朝廟製，神宗嘗命禮官陸佃討論，欲復古制，未及施行。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's temple design—Shenzong once ordered ritual official Lu Dian to deliberate, wishing to restore ancient regulation, but it was not implemented in time.
translations.idiomatic: Our temple design—Shenzong once ordered ritual official Lu Dian to deliberate on restoring antiquity, but it was never implemented.

sentences.zh: 渡江以來，稽古禮文之事，多所未暇。

translations.literal: Since crossing the river southward, matters of examining ancient ritual texts have largely been beyond our leisure.
translations.idiomatic: Since moving south across the Yangzi, examination of ancient ritual texts has largely been neglected.

sentences.zh: 今欲驟行 更革，恐未足以成其事，而徒為紛紛。

translations.literal: Now to wish to carry out sudden reform perhaps cannot accomplish the matter and will only create uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Sudden reform now may not succeed and will only create uproar.

sentences.zh: 或且仍遵本朝之制，自西徂東，並為一列。

translations.literal: Perhaps for the time being still follow our dynasty's regulation, from west to east all in one row.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps for now still follow our dynasty's arrangement, from west to east in a single row.

sentences.zh: 惟於每室之後，量展一間，以藏祧廟之主。

translations.literal: Only behind each chamber, extend one bay as measured, to store tablets from the distant shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Only behind each chamber, extend one bay to store distant-shrine tablets.

sentences.zh: 每室之前，量展二間，遇三年袷享，則 以帷幄幕之，通為一室，盡出諸廟主及祧廟主並為一列，合食其上。

translations.literal: Before each chamber, extend two bays as measured; when the triennial xia offering occurs, hang curtains and canopies, connecting them into one chamber, bring out all temple tablets and distant-shrine tablets in one row, and perform the joint feast upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Before each chamber, extend two bays; at triennial xia, hang curtains to form one hall, bring out all shrine and distant-shrine tablets in one row, and hold the joint feast there.

sentences.zh: 前乎此廟為一室，凡遇袷享，合祭於其室，名為袷享，而實未嘗合。

translations.literal: Previously this temple was one chamber; whenever xia occurred, joint sacrifice was in its chamber—called xia offering, yet in fact never truly joint.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the temple was one hall; at xia, sacrifice was called joint but was never truly combined.

sentences.zh: 今量展此三間，後有藏祧主 之所，前有祖宗合食之地，於本朝之制，初無大段更革，而頗已得三年大袷之義。

translations.literal: Now extending these three bays, there is behind a place to store distant-shrine tablets and before a place for ancestors' joint feast—in our dynasty's regulation, at first no great alteration, yet already largely obtaining the meaning of the triennial great xia.
translations.idiomatic: Extending these three bays provides storage for distant tablets behind and a true joint feast before—no great change to our arrangements, yet largely achieving the triennial great xia in spirit.

sentences.zh: 今來朝廷若能舉行朱熹前議，固無以加；

translations.literal: If the court can now implement Zhu Xi's earlier proposal, nothing could be better;
translations.idiomatic: If the court can implement Zhu Xi's earlier proposal, nothing could be better;

sentences.zh: 如其不然，姑從後說，亦為允當，不失禮 意。

translations.literal: if not, for the time being follow the latter proposal—it is also acceptable and does not lose ritual intent.
translations.idiomatic: if not, the latter proposal is also acceptable and preserves ritual intent.

sentences.zh: 然宗廟之禮，倘無其故，何敢妄議？

translations.literal: Yet regarding ancestral temple ritual, without such cause, how would one dare propose rashly?
translations.idiomatic: Yet on ancestral ritual, without such cause, who would dare propose changes?

sentences.zh: 今因大火之後，若加損益，亦惟其時，乞賜詳議。

translations.literal: Now after the great fire, if additions and subtractions are made, this too is the time—we beg detailed deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: After the great fire, if changes are to be made, the moment is now—we beg thorough deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」有旨，令侍從、禮部、太常集議，後竟不行。

translations.literal: " An order was issued for attendants, the Ministry of Rites, and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to assemble for deliberation; in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered attendants, the Ministry of Rites, and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to deliberate; in the end nothing was implemented.
